Things I've built

What I've shipped, and what I'm still working on.

Solo developer · 2026 – present

MetaVault

MetaVault is a Magic: The Gathering app. You can scan cards with your phone, see what your collection is worth, build decks, and track life totals in Commander games. I'm the only developer on it, so the web app, the iOS app, the backend, and getting through App Store review were all me.

Live on the App StoreLive on the web
meta-vault.appApp Store

  • Card scanning

    Point your camera at a card and it's in your collection a few seconds later. Apple Vision reads the text on the phone, then a fuzzy match against Scryfall picks the right card and scores how sure it is.

  • Apple Wallet passes

    Your collection shows up as an Apple Wallet pass. The passes are generated in Deno edge functions and updated every night with signed APNs pushes (ES256 JWTs through WebCrypto).

  • Live life tracker

    Everyone at the table sees the same game in real time, with turn tracking, life graphs, and a history of past games.

  • Deck builder

    Pick a commander and it builds the deck from cards you already own first, then fills in the rest from what people actually play. It's a rules engine on EDHREC and Commander Spellbook data with 72 tests, no AI model involved.

  • Backend and security

    Supabase Postgres with row-level security, nightly pg_cron jobs that snapshot collection values, custom auth email with SPF and DKIM, and Sign in with Apple that revokes tokens when you delete your account.

  • Shipping it

    The web app is React and Vite on AWS Amplify. The iOS app is React Native and Expo, built through EAS and TestFlight. There are 700+ automated tests running in CI.

  • App Store review

    Apple rejected it twice, once over the wording on a permission prompt and once over a login freeze on a new iOS version. I fixed both and it shipped.

  • Secret Lair browser

    Every Secret Lair drop, all 716 of them, matched to its cards by combining Scryfall and MTGJSON data.

  • TCGplayer prices

    Card prices link to TCGplayer through an approved affiliate account.

Personal project · 2026

Elden Ring mashups

I've been putting characters and game modes from other games into Elden Ring and posting the results on TikTok. It's a mod framework written in Rust, built with a lot of help from AI coding agents. Five of the clips are past a million views.

It started as Overwatch's Doomfist in first person, with his real HUD, cooldowns, and abilities. Since then I've added Dragon Ball FighterZ combat, Cyberpunk's Sandevistan, a Halo Banshee, and more. I try to make each one play the way it does in its own game.

Watch on TikTok
  • 19M+views across 20 TikTok posts
  • 6.7Mviews on the top clip
  • 2.4Mlikes on the account

  • Pulling assets out of each game

    I wrote readers for each game's file formats to get the models, animations, sounds, and HUD art out, like Fallout 4's archives and Havok animations and Halo's animation files. Unity games go through AssetRipper.

  • My code, Elden Ring's world

    Abilities, hit detection, physics, cameras, and HUDs are my own Rust code, timed off each game's real frame data. Elden Ring just provides the world, the enemies, and collision.

  • On TikTok so far

    Overwatch, Halo, Dragon Ball FighterZ, Cyberpunk 2077, Resident Evil 2, Zelda: Ocarina of Time in VR, and a Tesla Roadster.

About

Most of what I build started as something I wanted for myself.

I'm a systems analyst at San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, mostly working on payments and ticketing. Outside of work I'm usually working on MetaVault or a new Elden Ring mod, and I'm taking classes toward my master's at Johns Hopkins.

I got into software through esports and video editing. My degree is in Communications, and I spent five years running broadcasts and making content for SDSU Esports. That's probably why I care so much about how things look.

I use the Claude API at work and AI coding agents on my own projects. Wanting to understand how those systems actually work is a big reason I went back for my master's.
